title: Your GST Just Got Simpler: Big Changes Expected from the Next Council Meeting

faq.a: The GST Council is India's highest decision-making body for Goods and Services Tax, comprising the Union Finance Minister (as Chairperson) and state finance ministers. It recommends all major changes to GST laws, rates, and procedures.

faq.q: When is the 57th GST Council meeting happening?
faq.a: The 57th GST Council meeting is scheduled for October 7, 2026, in New Delhi.
Input Tax Credit (ITC) allows businesses to reduce the tax they pay on their final sales by the amount of tax they have already paid on their raw materials, goods, or services used in their business.

faq.q: How does a supplier default affect a buyer's ITC?
faq.a: Currently, if your supplier collects GST from you but doesn't deposit it with the government, you as the buyer might be denied the Input Tax Credit, even if you paid the full amount. The upcoming meeting aims to address this issue to protect genuine buyers.

faq.q: Will GST registration become fully automatic?
faq.a: While "GST 2.0" introduced simplified and faster registration for small, low-risk businesses, the Council is expected to propose further streamlining. However, for larger or higher-risk businesses, some level of verification or security deposit might still be required.
